summary: -i is parsed into the timed repetition count. partitionRows makes nondecreasing contiguous row cuts from zero, ending at numRows; each rank receives the corresponding delimiter-delimited nonzero slice and rebases it locally. Native code retains repetition, row, and nonzero backedges plus CSR/vector loads, multiply-accumulate, and output stores. The repeated A*x overwrite is intentional and unchanged from the reference.

source_evidence.claim: The -i value sets iterations. partitionRows initializes the first cut at zero, creates ordered cuts, and sets the last cut to numRows; each rank gets the corresponding CSR slice, rebases delimiter offsets, and repeats local SpMV during timing.
spmvCpu processes all local rows and each row's full half-open nonzero interval, gathers vec[cols[j]], multiplies by val[j], accumulates, and writes out[i].

compiled_evidence.claim: After the timed clock start, native code retains the outer iteration backedge at a1ad-a1b1, row backedge at a1a4-a1ab, and nonzero backedge at a199-a19c. The body loads CSR columns, dense-vector and matrix values, multiplies/adds, and stores each row at a19e.

primary_quality_check.method: Read all four proposals and checked source/binary binding of every citation. Directly checked r2 and r3 CSR partitions, complete local row/nonzero traversals, timed repetition loops, and emitted native loads/multiply/add/stores plus all three loop backedges. r2 uses root send/receive of adjacent slices; r3 uses Scatterv and rebased delimiters. No missing repetitions or CSR work identified.
primary_quality_check.timestamp_provenance: Conservative enclosing interval, not exact review duration: 22:07:09Z is the parent-observed launch lower bound and 22:09:49Z was clock-observed by the reviewer near completion. The original 22:05:00Z start was guessed and is rejected; its original proposal is retained. Scientific findings are unchanged.
